reason: A DSH Web GUI skin plugin that adds configurable interactive pixel cats without changing the underlying interface or model requests.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加可配置、可互动的像素猫皮肤，不改变原有布局或模型请求。
summaries.en: Adds configurable interactive pixel cats to the DSH Web GUI without changing the existing layout or model requests.

capabilities: Modifies the DSH Web GUI presentation layer with interactive pixel cats
Reads and writes localStorage for cat configuration
Performs an occasional read-only GitHub version check
